passages.quote: Retraction: Caffeine improves working memory in adults
The journal has retracted this article.
An institutional investigation found that the data in Figures 2 to 4 had been fabricated, and the conclusions cannot be relied on.
The primary outcome was n-back accuracy.
200 mg caffeine improved n-back accuracy by 12% compared with placebo. Figures 2 to 4 show accuracy by dose.
